title: How Far Will They Go? Red-Teaming Online Influence with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.22880v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly participate in online discourse, red-teaming their capacity to support political influence campaigns is critical for information integrity. In pursuit of this goal, we focus on locally deployable open-source LLMs under an assumed threat model in which an operator seeks to avoid detection, prioritizes throughput, and selects released LLM checkpoints without modifying their weights. We introduce an empirical red-teaming framework for measuring LLM Overton Windows (OWs), summarizing expression fidelity across sampled political opinions, and for quantifying how simple natural-language jailbreaks change these scores. We evaluate more than 30 LLMs spanning 10 model families and five countries of origin on English-language, US-focused target opinions. We find systematic asymmetries in political expressivity: models typically express sampled left-leaning content with higher fidelity, me

translated_title: 他们能走多远？利用大语言模型对网络影响力进行红队测试
translated_abstract: 随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体日益参与网络话语，通过红队测试评估其支持政治影响力活动的能力，对于维护信息完整性至关重要。为实现这一目标，我们聚焦于可在本地部署的开源LLM，并设定了一种威胁模型：操作者试图规避检测、优先考虑输出吞吐量，且仅选用已发布的LLM检查点而不修改其权重。我们提出了一个实证性红队测试框架，用于测量LLM的“Overton窗口”（Overton Windows，OWs），即对采样政治观点的表达保真度进行汇总，并量化简单的自然语言越狱攻击如何改变这些分数。我们在英语、以美国为目标观点的场景下，评估了来自10个模型家族、5个国家的30余个LLM。我们发现政治表达能力存在系统性不对称：模型通常以更高的保真度表达采样的左倾内容……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个实证红队测试框架，通过测量LLM的Overton窗口来量化本地部署的开源大语言模型表达政治观点的保真度以及简单越狱攻击对这些分数的影响，并发现模型在政治表达上存在系统性不对称（左倾内容的表达保真度通常更高）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an empirical red-teaming framework that measures LLM Overton Windows to quantify the political expression fidelity of locally deployable open-source LLMs and how simple natural-language jailbreaks shift these scores, revealing systematic asymmetries in political expressivity.
